source: NASA PDS Mars 2020 MEDA derived TIRS P04 and calibrated ATS P01
flags_note: RSM head outside upward FOV flag is 0 for all rows; wheel outside downward FOV flag missing for all rows. Results are exploratory and require instrument-specific interpretation and further QC.
ground_temperature_note: Not directly available in the supplied derived TIRS CSV; irradiance must not be labeled as ground temperature. Conversion requires an appropriate radiative transfer/emissivity calibration model.
ats_reference: NASA calibrated ATS Sol 15 P01, five independent local air temperature sensors
spatial_scope: Observations at the rover, not a temperature map for the 2 km x 2 km area
hourly_method: Arithmetic mean per LMST integer hour where available; TIRS filtered for unshadowed, low tilt, still rover; ATS five-sensor average per record. No time interpolation.
